did: Fixed a defect in how home reads a football game: ESPN writes a touchdown's extra point or two-point try into the touchdown's own text, and home was reading the try as part of the play, so a flag, a sack or a turnover on the try could change how the touchdown itself was told. Now only the moments about the try read it. The fix is held by a test that runs every kind of try against every kind of touchdown, 143 cases, and it raised the engine's version so the phone's copy moved with it. Four fresh reviews each found something real in the first versions, and each was fixed before merge. One older, separate misreading was filed for later.
left: server#1121: a No Play after a try word on a play with no touchdown is still missed; the fix and its test are written on the issue.
server#1102's three questions still wait on the owner.
